title: The install check reads a pnpm 12 lockfile, whose env document comes first
description: The install check parses `pnpm-lock.yaml` with `parse()`, which throws when a file holds more than one YAML document. pnpm 12 writes its env lockfile (the pnpm version it runs as) as a document before the project's. So every copy of a pnpm 12 project, 10db included, reads as having an unreadable lockfile, and each new task fails as a broken install before its first step ("1 of 0 dependencies … (pnpm-lock.yaml (unreadable))"). The check is `checkInstall` in apps/daemon/src/delivery/install-health.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: A pnpm 12 lockfile whose first document is the env lockfile reads as whole when the project's packages resolve
If any document fails to parse, the lockfile still counts as unreadable and the install as broken
A test fails with the report the lanes got before the change and passes after it
